name: LicenseSpec
description:
LicenseSpec is what an operator issues: who the license is for, what it
 permits and for how long.

 The spec is the source of the signed claims: at issue, the issuer builds
 LicenseClaims from it, the license's id and the signing instant, signs
 them, and records the ticket in the status. The spec is final at create;
 a license that must say something else is a new License.

fields.name: Customer
fields.description: Who the license is issued to.

fields.name: PlanId
fields.description:
The id of the Plan the entitlements were copied from. Empty when the
 entitlements are bespoke to this customer.

fields.name: Entitlements
fields.description:
What the license permits. Copied from the plan when plan_id is set, so
 the license reads whole without a lookup; written by hand otherwise.

fields.name: Term
fields.description: Whether the term is a trial or a paid license.

fields.name: GraceUntil
fields.description:
The end of the grace period after expiry, during which the licensed
 server keeps serving and reports the license as expired.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description:
Operator notes about this issuance (the order, the contact, the reason
 for a bespoke entitlement). Never signed, never shown to the customer.
